title: Bangladesh unrest: Bengal CM Suvendu to write to EAM, may push to extend minority entry cut-off

ai.summary: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari said he would contact India's external affairs minister to seek an extension of the December 31, 2024 cut-off date for religious minorities fleeing Bangladesh to enter India, citing concerns over escalating violence in the country.

facts.claim: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari said he would contact external affairs minister S Jaishankar on Monday to convey concerns in the state over the escalating violence in Bangladesh
facts.quote: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari on Sunday said he would contact external affairs minister S Jaishankar on Monday to convey concerns in the state over the escalating violence in Bangladesh.

facts.claim: Suvendu indicated that the government could seek an extension of the cut-off date for religious minorities fleeing the neighbouring country to enter India
facts.quote: He also indicated that the government could seek an extension of the cut-off date for religious minorities entering India from Bangladesh, if required.

facts.claim: Suvendu said the developments in Bangladesh were 'extremely painful' and had caused widespread concern in West Bengal
facts.quote: Suvendu said the developments in Bangladesh were "extremely painful" and had caused widespread concern in West Bengal, where many people have relatives across the border.

facts.claim: Suvendu said around two crore people in Bengal have relatives in Bangladesh
facts.quote: Around two crore people in Bengal have relatives there, and the developments are having an impact here as well.

facts.claim: Suvendu said he would write to the Centre to extend the timeline if required
facts.quote: If required, we will write to the Centre to extend the timeline," he told reporters.

facts.claim: Suvendu cited protocol, saying he cannot comment directly on foreign affairs
facts.quote: As the chief minister of a state, I cannot comment directly on foreign affairs. There is a protocol.

ai.background_note: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari is seeking an extension of the December 31, 2024 cut-off date for religious minorities fleeing Bangladesh to enter India amid escalating political violence in Bangladesh.
